evidence.claim: A clinical trial evaluating the GlucoMen Day CGM System in 8 participants with type 1 diabetes over a 14-day wear time demonstrated an overall Mean Absolute Relative Difference (MARD) of 9.7% against a laboratory reference (YSI) instrument, and an overall MARD of 13.1% compared to self-monitoring of blood glucose (SMBG).
Consensus Error Grid analysis from the study showed that 98% of data pairs fell within clinically acceptable zones A and B.

Sensor Accuracy & Reliability.assessed_on: The system's precise MARD, 14-day wear stability, and error grid percentages were verified via an independent peer-reviewed clinical trial, reflecting clear verifiable capability without achieving leading single-digit MARD metrics.
